description: Address critical review findings: (1) publish_chapter sets 'published' despite CF failure, (2) sync SearchClient blocks async event loop, (3) meta_description truncation cuts mid-word, (4) FAQ JSON-LD includes topics without definitions.
steps: Step 1: Fix publish_chapter in content_publisher.py to check CF result before setting status. If CF fails, still set status to published but include a warning in the response and log clearly. Response dict should indicate which services succeeded/failed.
Step 2: Wrap SearchClient.upload_documents in asyncio.to_thread() to avoid blocking the event loop.
Step 3: Fix meta_description truncation in content_generation.py to truncate at the last word boundary within 160 chars.
Step 4: Fix FAQ JSON-LD generation in admin_content.py to skip topics where definition is None or empty.
acceptance_criteria: publish_chapter response clearly indicates CF success/failure status
FAQ JSON-LD skips topics without definitions
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/-kalukaliya/apps/backend && JWT_SECRET='test-secret-at-least-32-characters-long' APP_ENV=development python -m pytest tests/test_content_generation.py tests/test_seo_pipeline.py -x -v --timeout=30
findings: All 4 fixes implemented and verified. 24 tests in test_content_generation.py and test_seo_pipeline.py pass. 57 tests across content model/endpoint tests also pass. Existing test for publish_chapter (test_publish_chapter_updates_status) still passes because it mocks CF to succeed. The asyncio.to_thread wrapper works transparently with mocked SearchClient.
